tool_args.rationale: The slow-horizon observations establish the predicted endogenous reversal and cover the target horizon. Fit the archived dual-exponential law numerically and test it on fresh confirmation data.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed response changes from positive to negative at long horizons, contrary to the archived monotone mechanisms.
All observations have zero sink gradient; the archived unsaturated dual-horizon law directly explains the observed reversal with fewer parameters.
The eight observations now span both short and long horizons and constrain the four-parameter candidate; fresh confirmation is more informative than another probe.
